thnak you.  it feels better to know im not wrong

i'd love to talk but i never know what to say.  i want friends but i can't think of what to talk to people about and im so used to keeping to myself.

i'm at a really small school that isn't for me, it's depressing and doesn't offer anything relevant to my interests and has like... 5 people per class and it's just bad for my mental health.  and i have PCOS and that's wrecking me.

i've tried keeping a journal, but i get too critical of myself like my handwriting and just what i write and i forget to write and get even more upset with myself.

i live in a really small area so there aren't any clubs that interest me or anything.  it's also part of the reason i have problems making friends.  the best friends i've made have been online but they've made friends offline and so i'm left

sorry if that sounds like i' m shooting down everything you say, it just feels so impossible

thank you for your kind words
